title: Clinical Exercise Physiologist
keyRequirements: ACSM Clinical Exercise Physiologist (ACSM-CEP) or equivalent certification
Experience working with clinical populations, especially cardiometabolic conditions
Background in cardiac or pulmonary rehabilitation strongly preferred
Strong understanding of exercise prescription and risk stratification
Experience using or supporting wearables and health tech platforms
Highly organized with strong attention to detail
Self-starter who can operate independently in a fast-paced, early-stage environment
preferredSkills: Comfort working in a protocol-driven, data-informed care environment
Experience with wearable and biometric data monitoring
notes: This is a contract role. Care is delivered via live video sessions and asynchronous messaging. Members are supported through a combination of personalized exercise programming, wearable data monitoring, and in-app communication.
